extraction_notes: Datasheet type number is PMV65XPEA; PMV65XPEAR is the tape-and-reel ordering variant of the same die/package (SOT23, TO-236AB). Target MPN identity preserved as PMV65XPEAR.
P-channel signed quantities preserved exactly as printed on datasheet axes and tables: VDS, VGS, ID, VSD and V(BR)DSS are negative; RDSon and capacitances are positive magnitudes.
Curve points digitized by inspection of 300 dpi page renders of Fig. 6 (output), Fig. 10 (transfer) and Fig. 13 (capacitances). Estimated digitization uncertainty roughly 5-10 percent of reading.

Consistency checks against Table 7: ohmic slope of the VGS = -4.5 V output branch matches RDSon typ 67 mohm; Fig. 13 readings at VDS = -10 V (approx 610/82/59 pF) match table Ciss/Coss/Crss 618/80/58 pF; transfer-curve slope near ID = -2 A is consistent with gfs typ 7.4 S within digitization error.
Capacitance curves use log-log axes labeled -10^-1 to -10^2 V; log scale applies to |VDS| while signs are preserved in the recorded x values.
Sub-threshold Fig. 7, SOA Fig. 3, gate-charge Fig. 14 and diode Fig. 16 were examined but not digitized; table values cover threshold, gate charge (QG(tot) typ 5 nC) and VSD.

Additional table facts not schema-mapped: gfs typ 7.4 S (VDS = -10 V, ID = -2 A); RG typ 11.6 ohm at 1 MHz; QG(tot) typ 5 nC max 9 nC, QGS typ 1.1 nC, QGD typ 1.1 nC (VDS = -10 V, ID = -2.8 A, VGS = -4.5 V); IDSS max -1 uA at VDS = -20 V; ID max -3.3 A (t <= 5 s), IDM -12 A; ESD HBM 2 kV; AEC-Q101.
Source: public Nexperia product datasheet only; no vendor SPICE or model packs used.
